headline: Board reviews Wallingford High School education specifications, financial reports, bylaw revisions, and candidates for business manager.
summary: The meeting covers proposed education specifications for a new Wallingford High School, financial and food service reports, several bylaw and policy revisions, committee updates, and executive session discussions on resignations and a business manager appointment.
